## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results.

## Handoff checklist

- [ ] `docs/HANDOFF.md` has been updated for this change.
- [ ] The handoff includes validation, blockers, and exact next actions.
- [ ] Permanent decisions are documented outside the handoff and linked from it.
- [ ] No secrets, raw internal reports, employee names, or talent assessments are included.
- [ ] The staged diff has been reviewed before push.
